description:
Job Description


Sobre a Ocyan:


Somos uma fornecedora do setor de óleo e gás e novas energias com grande expertise e excelência técnica. Contamos com uma cultura forte que permeia todos os nossos negócios, além de um compromisso sério de curto, médio e longo prazo em nossa agenda ESG que permeia segurança de nossas operações e pessoas, relacionamento com as comunidades em que atuamos, diversidade, neutralidade de carbono e energia limpa.


Atuamos com soluções para a indústria offshore nas áreas de produção de petróleo, por meio da joint-venture Altera&Ocyan; serviços de construção submarina e descomissionamento offshore, além de manutenção de ativos. Também atuamos na revitalização de malha de gás por meio do Consórcio Ocyan&Mota-Engil. Possuímos ainda participação acionária minoritária na Foresea, empresa do segmento de perfuração offshore. A Ocyan também avança em estudos e projetos relacionados a novos serviços e energias, tecnologias e Corporate Venture Capital.


Sobre o Projeto Malha De Gás


O Consórcio Ocyan&Mota-Engil foi formado em 2023 quando a Ocyan conquistou um contrato para executar a revitalização da malha de gás da Petrobras na Bacia de Campos. A atividade offshore será realizada junto às plataformas de Namorado e Garoupa (PNA-1 e PGP-1), incluindo instalação de equipamentos submarinos como manifolds e dutos flexíveis.


O consórcio é formado pela Ocyan e pela Mota-Engil, uma companhia portuguesa com grande atuação internacional.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Execução avançada de modelos 3D de equipamentos submarinos em software CAD
  • Execução de Deck Layout, Storyboard, Liftplan, seafastening e desenhos relacionados à Instalação e Operações Offshore
  • Execução de Arranjo Geral de equipamentos submarinos
  • Elaboração de desenhos e estudos de acordo com inputs da disciplina de Engenharia / Construção, conforme normas técnicas
  • Submeter esboços desenvolvidos e fornecer justificativas para correções e ajustes
  • Elaborar desenhos dos projetos, definindo suas características e estágios de execução
  • Identificar, contribuir e implementar melhorias para aumentar a performance operacional

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Curso técnico em Mecânica, Estruturas Navais, Máquinas Navais ou Mecatrônica
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos EPCI relacionados a equipamentos e operações de interligação submarina (mínimo 8 anos)
  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas CAD (2D & 3D), como SolidWorks, Inventor, AutoCAD
  • Pacote Office
  • Inglês básico
  • Proatividade
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita

Additional information

Contratação por tempo determinado de 6 meses, com possível renovação por mais 6 meses.

Process stages

  • Step 1: Registration
  • Step 2: Mapeamento de RH
  • Step 3: Entrevista RH
  • Step 4: Entrevista Técnica
  • Step 5: Processo Admissional
  • Step 6: Hiring

Nosso propósito é ser uma empresa transparente, tecnicamente capacitada e sustentável, oferecendo soluções para a indústria de óleo e gás upstream offshore no Brasil e no exterior.

FAÇA PARTE DA NOSSA EQUIPE

A Ocyan atua há décadas na prestação de serviços para o setor de óleo e gás upstream, com alta qualidade e capacidade técnica.

Valorizamos nossos 9 Valores, que incluem segurança, ética, satisfação do cliente, potencial humano, espírito de serviço, diversidade, inovação, sustentabilidade e transparência.

Faça parte da nossa equipe! Contamos com a sua energia!

title: Procurement Manager - Logistics NA
description:
ABOUT UNILEVER

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. Our strategy begins with a purpose that places consumers at the heart of everything we do: Brighten everyday life for all. Our goal is to deliver best-in-class performance with market-making, unmissably superior brands. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our collaborative, and flexible working environment. Our organizational ambition centers around creating workplaces that foster equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging across all aspects of our business. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

ABOUT PROCUREMENT

Part of the Supply Chain family, Procurement is responsible for over 30B Euro of material and services spend globally with more than 60,000 suppliers. Getting the right services and materials, sustainably sourced and ensuring responsible procurement is critical to ensuring our brands with purpose grow. Our teams work closely with the business to understand stakeholders needs, bring innovation to meet changing consumer, employees and customers needs, and drive financial value for Unilever through competitive buying. We’re at the forefront of digital procurement, bringing new tools and analytics to drive data-based decisions. Our strategy is ‘Procurement with Purpose’ and focuses on buying responsibly, buying better, and growing together with partners around the world. Our ambition is based on three key drivers: being Purpose-Led, Value-Driven, and Future-Fit.

Purpose:

The Procurement Manager for Logistics in North America will be responsible for supporting the sourcing strategy development and assisting with the procurement of transportation services for the US, Canada, and Mexico. This position is responsible for business partnering with logistics function at a market level to land relevant capabilities that drive service, value creation, and responsible sourcing in the markets. This role will partner with two peer managers to support the procurement of multiple modes of freight in the network.

Who You Are and What You'll Do

This role will support the buying activities of the North America network including but not limited to:

  1. Following the standard 7-step strategic procurement process from strategy alignment and market scans to supporting Request for Proposals and contract discussions to business approval, contract signing, and operational implementation.
  2. Support preparation of executive level briefs on the negotiation strategy for annual bids for review by the Global Head of Logistics Procurement and Chief Procurement Officer.
  3. Maintain market intelligence to forecast future cost structures with internal stakeholders in Logistics and Finance.
  4. Identify disruptive emerging technologies to create capacity or innovation for the business, e.g., autonomous trucking, paperless BOLs, API integration, etc.
  5. Support any North American logistics network redesign projects to identify capacity solutions and providers that provide the right end to end need for cost, capacity, and service.
  6. Business partnering to the Logistics operations team in the markets to deliver savings projects while achieving service level targets.
  7. Support Global benchmarking project work for Transportation to gain and maintain cost transparency and competitive buying for North America.
  8. Maintain productive relationships with external 3PL carrier partners, organizing strategic business reviews and joint business development plans with Strategic partners.
  9. Support the development and implementation of the North America Sustainability Roadmap to decarbonize Unilever’s carbon emissions by 2039.
  10. Develop opportunities to decouple the value chain for transportation with carriers and other external partners to drive competitive advantage and savings for Unilever.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  1. Bachelor’s Degree required with preference in Logistics, Supply Chain, or other Business field.
  2. Relevant Procurement or Logistics experience required, preferably in Consumer-Packaged Goods company.
  3. Knowledge and experience of the Strategic Procurement Process and application in Logistics.
  4. Understanding of Value Chain of transportation and demonstrated ability to extract costs via Should Cost models.
  5. Experience negotiating cost variables with transportation providers leading to successful outcomes.
  6. Awareness of transportation providers and market intelligence sources in North America.
  7. Proven abilities in stakeholder management, with an emphasis on listening and influencing.
  8. Experience working with enterprise level logistics systems, such as a Transportation or Yard.
  9. Fluency in English in written and verbal forms.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. ASCM/APICS certification in CLTD or CSCP
  2. CSCMP SCPro certification
  3. Formal negotiation training or experience
  4. SAP, Oracle TMS, JDA WMS, Jaggaer contracting, and PINC YMS experience are preferred

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities.   • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity

description:
Curso Formação MCSA SQL Server 2016 Expert

Objetivo da Formação MCSA SQL Server 2016 Expert:

Autenticar e autorizar usuários

Este módulo abrange usuários, logins e modelos de segurança do SQL Server.

Atribuição de funções de banco de dados e servidor
Este módulo abrange funções de servidor fixas, funções de servidor definido pelo usuário, funções fixas de banco de dados e funções de banco de dados definido pelo usuário.

Autorizar os usuários para acessar recursos
Este módulo abrange a atribuição de permissões e permissões.

Auditoria e proteção de dados com criptografia
Este módulo aborda a auditoria do SQL Server.

Modelos de recuperação SQL Server
Este módulo descreve o conceito do log de transações e modelos de recuperação de SQL Server. Ele também introduz as diferentes estratégias de backup disponíveis com o SQL Server.

Restaurando bancos de dados do SQL Server
Este módulo descreve a restauração de bancos de dados.

Automatizando o gerenciamento do SQL Server
Este módulo descreve como usar o SQL Server Agent para automação. Ele também explica os benefícios de usar servidores mestre e alvo descentralizar a administração de automação.

Configurando a segurança para o SQL Server Agent
Este módulo descreve as considerações para a segurança do SQL Server Agent, incluindo as credenciais e as contas de proxy.

Módulo 10 ? Monitoramento do SQL Server com alertas e notificações
Este módulo aborda a configuração do database mail, alertas e notificações.

Introdução ao gerenciamento do SQL Server usando o PowerShell
Este módulo introduz o PowerShell do SQL Server.

Rastreamento de acesso ao SQL Server
Este módulo descreve como usar o SQL Profiler e procedimentos armazenados do rastreamento SQL para capturar informações sobre o SQL Server. O módulo também descreve como usar o Distributed Replay para capturar informações de rastreamento de vários servidores e como monitorar o bloqueio.

Monitoramento do SQL Server
Este módulo explica como usar exibições de gerenciamento distribuído para monitorar o SQL Server. Ele também descreve a configuração de coleta de dados e SQL Server Utility.

Módulo 14 ? Solucionando problemas de SQL Server
Este módulo explica o SQL Server, solução de problemas de metodologia e discute os problemas mais comuns que podem surgir quando se trabalha com sistemas de SQL Server.

Módulo 15 ? Importação e exportação de dados
Este módulo aborda o uso de assistentes de importação/exportação e explica como eles se relacionam com o SSIS. O módulo também apresenta BCP e BULK INSERT.

SQL Server 2016 componentes
Descreva a plataforma SQL Server, SQL Server serviços e opções de configuração do SQL Server.

Atualizando do SQL Server para o SQL Server 2016
Este módulo descreve como atualizar sua instalação atual do SQL Server para o SQL Server 2016.

Implantar o SQL Server na Microsoft Azure
Este módulo descreve as opções disponíveis para executar o SQL Server no Azure.

Trabalhando com bancos de dados
Este módulo descreve os bancos de dados do sistema pré-instalado, a estrutura física das bases de dados e as opções de configuração mais comuns relacionadas a eles.

Opções de armazenamento de banco de dados
No final deste módulo, você será capaz de descrever as opções de armazenamento de banco de dados.

Executar a manutenção de banco de dados
Este módulo abrange manutenção de banco de dados.

The Business Area Controlling Maintenance & Cloud Team is responsible for actively managing the Topline for SAP’s Cloud & Maintenance business for 6 of SAP regions (EMEA North, EMEA South, MEE, APJ, NA and LAC). The team is responsible for the implementation and optimization of planning models as well as forecast and actual analyses covering all market units within the regional scope. To successfully manage this task and to further strengthen our support for the business we are looking for a Senior Controller. In this role, you will contribute to steering of SAP’s biggest revenue stream.

EXPECTATIONS AND TASKS

  • Supporting the maintenance & cloud revenue for Market Unit (MU) LAC SOUTH in LAC region on all controlling aspects like budget, forecast and Actual analysis.
  • Responsible for forecasting the Support & Cloud Revenue at the Market Unit level working closely with the regional/Global CoE, maintenance business leaders as well as Global Finance Shared Services (GFSS) functions and Global controlling.
  • Coordinate the conceptual enhancement of current controlling models and processes around Maintenance and Cloud.
  • Communicate proactively with key business stakeholders especially top management in Controlling/Finance and Maintenance Business; provide them with analysis and reporting.
  • Act as a trusted advisor for financial topics around maintenance & Cloud, enhanced with strategic business knowhow for present and forward-looking trends (ex. planning process).
  • Work closely with global teams for monitoring extension policies effects and backup forecast one-pager deliverables within regional CoE Maintenance team & Cloud COE team.
  • Nurture and enhance Maintenance & Cloud Engagement model, driving continuous improvement process, acting as real orchestrator, and showing ability to connect across various layers in the organization, especially in the context of simplification / automation.

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

Required skills

  • Very strong analytical skills, conceptual and structured thinking.

  • Excellent skills in MS Office especially Excel and PowerPoint. Experience in other common analytics applications and SAP BW is a requirement.

  • Strong skills in root cause analysis in ERP & potentially RAR systems as well diagnosing inefficiencies in business processes and initiating and completing corrective actions.

Preferred skills

  • Highly experienced on SAP system and processes would be a significant strength.
  • Knowledge of working in a Controlling environment with a decentralized “field” working model would be a significant strength.
  • Proven ability to drive business transformation and execution against ambitious milestones.
  • Knowledge and/or experience of Maintenance Business Model would be an advantage.

WORK EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 4 to 5 years professional work experience with a strong focus on controlling and/or accounting, preferably with a current role at an MU/Regional level across various LOBs. Ideally, some knowledge in maintenance revenue models would be a plus (i.e. Point-In-Time revenue stream).

Vaga: Aplicador ABA - Estudante de Fonoaudiologia. O Instituto Almai nasceu da união de profissionais da área da saúde, com ampla experiência profissional, que tem um sonho em comum: produzir mudanças significativas e duradouras na vida dos pacientes com diferentes transtornos de neurodesenvolvimento, impactando positivamente à família e sociedade. Nosso diferencial é o tratamento humanizado, aliado a expertise em análise do Comportamento Aplicado (ABA), onde são desenvolvidas as intervenções terapêuticas no paciente, além do acolhimento familiar.

Estamos buscando um Aplicador ABA para se juntar ao nosso time. O Aplicador ABA é responsável por implementar e monitorar intervenções baseadas na Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) para promover o desenvolvimento da comunicação, linguagem e habilidades sociais dos pacientes, colaborando com a equipe de fonoaudiologia e outros profissionais da equipe multidisciplinar.

Responsabilidades

  1. Auxiliar diariamente os fonoaudiólogos nos atendimentos personalizados, de acordo com o perfil e necessidades do paciente, voltados para a estimulação da fala, implementação de comunicação alternativa, reabilitação fonoaudiológica, avaliações/exercícios miofuncionais e aplicação/orientação dos treinos ABA, a fim de assegurar a evolução do paciente.
  2. Participar ativamente na elaboração do plano terapêutico individualizado, estabelecido pelo fonoaudiólogo e auxiliar na execução dos atendimentos e avaliações clínicas.
  3. Registrar diariamente no drive da Unidade, em cada pasta do paciente, os objetivos e demandas trabalhadas, a fim de acompanhar sua evolução clínica, a serem aprovadas pelo fonoaudiólogo.

Conhecimentos Específicos

Cursando Ensino Superior em Fonoaudiologia. Curso de aplicador ABA.

Local

Rua Santa Cruz, 134.

description:
Company and Role Overview


At BotCity, we’ve built a pioneering Intelligent Automation platform, backed by global investors such as Y Combinator and SoftBank. Our mission is to empower enterprises worldwide to scale their automation initiatives with best-in-class governance, orchestration, and developer tools. We believe that automation projects are fundamentally software projects, which is why we advocate a high-code approach rooted in Python. Our commitment to innovation has enabled us to serve over 1,000 companies in 73 countries, and we continue to expand through strategic partnerships around the globe.

In 2024, we were honored to be recognized by G2.com as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, standing alongside industry titans like MidJourney, WhatsApp Business, and Slack. We were also celebrated as a Major Contender in the Everest Peak Matrix and recognized by Endeavor as a ScaleUp in 2023 and a YC Company in 2022. We are growing double-digits from the last 3 years, with teams across Brazil and the US, with a global vision and understanding Brazil as one of our markets.

As a Senior Java Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting and developing complex Java backend applications with a strong focus on scalability, performance, and reliability. Leveraging your deep expertise in the Spring Framework, you will design and implement robust, secure microservices that drive automation at the core of some of the world’s largest and most security-conscious enterprises.

About the Role
Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable backend applications developed in Java / Spring Framework.
  • Ensure high performance and availability of applications within a microservices architecture.
  • Collaborate with product managers to understand requirements, ensure its technical feasibility, and translate them into reliable and scalable solutions.
  • Participate in software engineering rituals to model complex applications.
  • Define private and public APIs for a world-class product.
  • Participate in code reviews, ensuring best practices in backend development.
  • Write high-quality technical documentation to clearly communicate backend architecture and API design, ensuring ease of understanding and effective collaboration across teams.

Job Location

Job Description

The Digital and IT Site Leader is responsible for defining and implementing the site’s digital master plan, aligning it with essential business needs. This role involves leading a multi-functional digital team at the site and collaborating with GBS service lines to achieve site operational targets, ensure compliance, and generate substantial value creation results.

Key Responsibilities:

Define and Drive the Digital Master Plan for the Site (30% of capacity)

  • Actively participate as a member of the site leadership team.
  • Develop the digital master plan for the site in line with the Business Unit (BU) and the site’s compelling business need.
  • Ensure the master plan includes strategic interventions to optimize data architecture, enabling predictive analytics and value acceleration. Coach teams on the successful delivery of these programs/projects.
  • Reflect the digital master plan in the portfolio tool (1PT) to track progress and outcomes.
  • Lead regular digital portfolio reviews with key stakeholders from the site, central BU organization, and Global Business Services (GBS).
  • Collaborate with GBS service line leaders/Single Points of Contact (SPOCs) to achieve the site’s operational targets, drive business growth and value, and enable the progression of the Integrated Work System (IWS) framework's digital pillar.
  • Lead the coordination of the multi-functional digital team’s master plan.
  • Act as a thought leader and provide critical input to the master plan to ensure outcomes are achieved.
  • Ensure alignment with P&G’s “Smart from the Start” strategy for site expansion projects.

Lead and Deliver Value for the Site and/or Category (40% of capacity)

  • Lead at least one top digital project per year to enable site and/or category value.
  • Conduct at least one digital pilot per year leveraging P&G Data Architecture, AI, and Manufacturing Data Flow (MDF) architecture, bringing AI use cases to life to deliver business value.
  • Anticipate and align future Digital Solutions/Investment opportunities with BU leadership and service lines, including data loss opportunities as part of loss elimination efforts.

Ensure Operational Excellence and IT Controls - Audits Ready Every Day (20% of capacity)

Manage the Site Data and Technology Budget (10% of capacity)

P&G is the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world. We have operations in over 75 countries, with 65 trusted brands that improve lives for 5 billion consumers worldwide. This brings many advantages, including the opportunity for our employees to enjoy a diverse and rewarding lifelong career filled with new and exciting challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. Our mission of Equality and Inclusion is: “Everyone valued. Everyone included. Everyone performing at their peak”.

We seek the most diverse talent so that we always know how to innovate to exceed the expectations of our consumers. We offer meaningful challenges from day one and effective and constant training. Thus, we bring to bear the strengths of our employees and develop them to become phenomenal leaders, reaching the highest levels of management. Working with us is the best opportunity to do what you love, with constant challenges and to be recognized for its results. More than that, it's the ideal opportunity to help us touch and improve billions of lives in our world.

For over 175 years, we have built some of the world’s most successful brands, including Always, Ariel, Aussie, Clearblue, Downy, Gillette, Head and Shoulders, Oral-B, Pampers, Pantene and Vick.

Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

description:

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Server - cloud-init role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Server - cloud-init role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Ubuntu Server is the world's most popular Linux - on cloud and bare metal. In this role, you will manage the team delivering cloud-init - the standard for customizing cloud instances - to the world.
Driving early system config is so much broader than just Ubuntu on a server. Cloud-init supports various distributions and underlying underlying platforms. That provides a great opportunity to work with:

  • Cloud providers to add features/integration and improve efficiency.
  • The whole cloud-init community from individual users and developers to major contributing companies.
  • Distributions to update their builds and coordinate their needs.
You'll be fully owning the product allowing you to influence its evolution and interact with many teams and partners to coordinate new features, enhancements and integration into various platforms.
The successful applicant will be passionate about the future of cloud-init, mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and aware of the needs of large, innovative customers.
This is an exciting opportunity for a leader passionate about strong teams, open source software and Ubuntu. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
What you'll do
  • Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Work with Product Management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu and your team
  • Effectively set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Participate in strong engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners
  • Oversee the quality of the Ubuntu Server image family
  • Plan and deliver Ubuntu Server features
  • Work from home with global travel for up to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have 3+ years of experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers. Experience managing distributed teams is a plus.
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience working in an agile development environment
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills in english
  • you have experience with a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Practical experience with at least 1 of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or Amazon Web Services
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Translate product requirements into robust technical solutions, recommend alternative approaches and lead engineering efforts to meet ambitious targets
Design and implement reliable systems and applications in the context of a fully distributed micro-services architecture

Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for all solutions, including architecture designs, APIs, workflows, and system configurations.
Continuously monitor Rain systems and applications for opportunities to maximize performance and scalability
Effective cross-team communication and collaboration to align priorities, clarify requirements, identify dependencies, and ensure seamless coordination throughout the software development lifecycle.

5+ years of Software Development experience

Strong expertise in designing and developing RESTful APIs
Experience with both SQL and NoSQL database technologies and strong understanding of database concepts and internals, including data model design and optimization principles
Experience at building reliable and scalable user-facing applications
Proficiency in designing and implementing scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures, with a strong ability to meet performance and scalability requirements
Excellent collaboration skills, with the capacity to work effectively with cross-functional teams, present ideas, and communicate technical concepts clearly

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

description:

We are looking for an Accounting Analyst who is passionate about being involved in a growing business unit!

About the Role

This is a role where you will be a key player in the end-to-end preparation of the financial close of non-technical entities, which is performed based on the locally generally accepted accounting principles (BRGAAP). Additionally, you will be required to search for ways of improving the accounting related processes that are current in place.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support on the preparation of financial close schedule.
  • Coordinate with all parties involved in the financial close to make sure it is finalized in a reasonable timeframe.
  • Ensure that all accounting entries are BRGAAP compliant.
  • Perform journal entries on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Reconciliation of balance sheet and income statement financial accounts.
  • Provide the management with ad-hoc reports.

About the Team

Finance Brazil is responsible for statutory and regulatory reports for all Swiss Re entities in Brazil, covering local and admitted reinsurers, an insurance company, one service company and one holding company. With more than 30 employees located in São Paulo, the team also provides services for the business team by providing strategics inputs for the development of the company in the country.

About You

You are a great communicator with superior organization, and you complement your excellent analytical skills with a holistic financial approach.

Must Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting.
  • At least three years of work experience in financial close activities.
  • Strong analytical skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the insurance industry.
  • CPA certification.
  • Intermediate ability to communicate clearly, read and write in English.

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for people with disabilities in all our positions.

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 15.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Objetivo do Cargo:

O Analista de Operações Portuárias Pleno será responsável pela coordenação e otimização das atividades logísticas e operacionais no terminal hidroviário de Pederneiras, garantindo a eficiência, segurança e conformidade dos processos relacionados a tripulação das embarcações.

  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Apoiar a capacitação de equipes internas e parceiros para assegurar que todos os envolvidos nas operações portuárias estejam alinhados com as melhores práticas e normas de segurança.

  • Local de trabalho: Porto ou terminal portuário.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais, se necessário.
  • Carga horária: Segunda a sexta-feira, com possibilidade de horas extras ou escalas de plantão, conforme demanda operacional.

Qualificações

  • Formação: Graduação em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia na área de operações portuárias ou logística, preferencialmente com experiência em cargos de nível pleno.
  • Conhecimento em processos logísticos e portuários, principalmente relacionados à movimentação de cargas e serviços aduaneiros.
  • Conhecimento sobre regulamentações e normas de segurança portuária.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de processos e análise de indicadores (KPIs).
  • Idiomas: Conhecimento intermediário em inglês pode ser um diferencial, especialmente para interações com clientes e fornecedores internacionais.
  • Informática: Domínio de ferramentas do pacote Office (principalmente Excel) e sistemas de gestão de operações portuárias.

Habilidades e Competências:

  • Capacidade de resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal para lidar com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade analítica.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de adaptação em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Conhecimento sobre segurança no trabalho e normas ambientais aplicáveis.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade:

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade:

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

description:

Join to apply for the Software Support Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Support Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Associate Director of Creative (AI)
description:
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

We are looking for an experienced and talented Associate Director of Creative to join our team.

The Associate Director of Creative is a player/coach designer who will work as a manager of a pod of Designers, as well as delivering your own AI-powered Creative Direction, Marketing Design, and UI/UX Design engagements at a high bar of client services and visual quality. You bring expertise in integrating AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Midjourney into your workflows to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding new ways to use AI to break barriers and being on the cutting edge of this paradigm shift.

In this role, you’ll report to the Director of Creative. You’ll use your strong design background to be an advocate for our design processes and philosophy, and supervise a small cohort of Designers by providing feedback on their work to develop their skillsets across paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. Your main focus in the first 60 days will be helping the creative team integrate ChatGPT and AI into their work to discover and implement efficiencies. You’ll bring your expertise in AI workflows to help build processes and trainings with the Director of Creative. You’ll also be responsible for owning Creative Direction engagements that impact paid marketing and organic channels for e-commerce clients.

We’re looking for a candidate with deep experience in using AI to power their work at a commercial level, and who can apply this experience to the direction and development of junior designers. A strong candidate has a best-in-class visual eye, attention-to-detail, and client services acumen.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Management Responsibilities:

  1. Manage a team of designers, starting with 1-2 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  2. Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  3. Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  4. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  5. Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  1. Be a champion for AI-powered work, holding trainings on best practices for the team and building efficient workflows for the team in partnership with the Director of Creative.

  2. Lead Creative Direction engagements focused on transforming paid or organic marketing channels through deliverables like content calendars, creative briefs, and strategic proposals.

  3. Lead 1-2 UI/UX engagements as capacity allows, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites. Emphasize branded UI, conversion-focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  4. Present design and creative direction work to clients, explaining choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  5. Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand-off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  6. Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  1. 3-6+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in creative direction, marketing design, or responsive web design.

  2. Digital portfolio showcasing web design, marketing design, and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  3. Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  4. Experience working with AI tools and producing client-ready assets powered by AI outputs is required.

  5. Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand-off.

  6. Comfortable with client-facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  7. Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  8. Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  9. Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  10. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.

O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

description:

Missão da Área

A área de Compras Diretas da Track&Field tem como objetivo garantir o fornecimento eficiente, econômico e pontual de materiais, produtos e serviços para a rede de lojas. Atua na identificação e negociação com fornecedores, assegurando qualidade, custo-benefício e cumprimento de prazos, além de gerenciar estoques e contribuir para a eficiência operacional e o sucesso da empresa.

Sua missão

Desempenhar um papel essencial no suporte à estratégia de compras da empresa, focando na aquisição de produtos, matérias-primas e insumos dentro dos padrões de qualidade e orçamento estabelecidos. Sua missão é realizar negociações eficazes com fornecedores, manter relações sólidas e confiáveis com parceiros e otimizar os processos de compra, contribuindo para a disponibilidade de produtos no tempo adequado e com o melhor custo-benefício.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

#Realizar negociações de compras de matérias-primas, produtos acabados e insumos têxteis, assegurando boas condições comerciais para a empresa;

#Desenvolver e gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores, buscando fortalecer parcerias estratégicas e garantir a continuidade do fornecimento;

#Garantir o abastecimento eficiente das unidades, analisando as necessidades de compra e ajustando os pedidos conforme a demanda;

#Executar o processo de compra com precisão, acompanhando o cumprimento dos prazos e monitorando a qualidade dos produtos adquiridos;

#Monitorar o mercado e tendências para identificar oportunidades de economia e otimização no processo de compras;

#Acompanhar os níveis de estoque e propor ajustes nas compras para evitar desperdícios ou rupturas;

#Manter registros detalhados e organizados das transações de compras, contratos e condições negociadas, assegurando compliance e alinhamento com as políticas internas;

#Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes internas, como logística e estoque, para garantir o fluxo de suprimentos conforme as necessidades operacionais;

#Contribuir para o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de processos e procedimentos na área de compras, sugerindo melhorias para aumentar a eficiência;

#Assegurar o cumprimento de padrões éticos e regulamentações aplicáveis em todas as atividades de compra.

Na área de Compras, é fundamental ter proatividade para antecipar e resolver problemas antes que impactem as operações. O foco em resultados garante o cumprimento de metas e a melhoria contínua da eficiência dos processos. Uma comunicação clara e objetiva é essencial para manter o alinhamento entre fornecedores e equipes internas. Além disso, a organização e a atenção aos detalhes permitem o gerenciamento preciso de múltiplas demandas, assegurando exatidão em registros e negociações. A adaptabilidade se mostra indispensável diante de mudanças e imprevistos do dia a dia, enquanto a ética e o senso de responsabilidade são pilares para conduzir todas as transações de forma íntegra e alinhada às políticas da empresa.

Habilidades

#Conhecimento em estratégias de negociação e gerenciamento de contratos;

#Familiaridade com processos de compras de produtos acabados, tecidos, insumos têxteis e cadeia de suprimentos no setor de moda e varejo;

#Experiência no uso de sistemas ERP (desejável LINX), com foco em módulos de compras, produção e estoque;

#Habilidade no uso de ferramentas de análise de dados e planilhas avançadas (Excel, Google Sheets) para monitoramento de KPIs e controle de custos;

#Conhecimento em compliance e regulamentos relacionados a compras e contratos comerciais;

#Desejável conhecimento básico de metodologias de gestão de projetos e ferramentas colaborativas (por exemplo, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Trello).

Job description

Registrar os produtos adquiridos pelos clientes, fazer as devidas cobranças e atendê-los da melhor forma possível.


Main responsibilities

  1. Abrir o terminal de Caixa (PDV), verificar com a chefia o caixa/posto em que estará alocado no dia, verificar a funcionalidade do equipamento, informar login e senha para iniciar a operação e o atendimento aos clientes;

  5. Explicar sobre o Programa de Fidelidade, bem como ofertar campanhas vinculadas ao programa quando houver;

  8. Auxiliar na reposição e devolução de produtos descartados pelos clientes por motivo de desistência, bem como ajudar no recolhimento de carrinhos de clientes no estacionamento quando necessário;
  9. Fazer o fechamento de caixa diário, contar os valores em espécie (dinheiro), retirar relatório de pagamentos via cartão de débito/crédito, fazer a sangria e alocar os valores em malote. Na ocorrência de falta de valores, assinar o Relatório de Quebra/Sobra de Caixa emitido pela Zanthus.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of work experience in a technical role (e.g., software engineering, solutions consultant, etc.) or equivalent technical experience.
  • Experience speaking at technology conferences, blogging/writing technical articles with an existing follower base, or contributing to a popular open source project.
  • Experience in the areas of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence or GenAI, including ability to guide developers on the use of these technologies.
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese and English fluently to support the local and global developer community.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in coding/engineering beneficial to the technical domain.
  • Ability to take ownership of solutions and exert influence without authority.
  • Ability to work globally and collaboratively in a team environment, be diplomatic, and influence technical practitioners, stakeholders, and globally distributed teams.
  • Ability to share technical knowledge and information with others.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate in Spanish fluently to support the community in the LATAM region.

About the job

Passionate people are everywhere at Google. In Developer Relations, we get excited to collaborate and connect with the communities that love technology as much as we do. Part community manager and part developer advocate, Developer Relations Engineers collaborate with developers at conferences and online, and advocate for developers interests internally at Google. Not afraid to be hands-on, you write sample code and client libraries as well as participate in developer forums and support queues to troubleshoot and debug coding problems developers encounter. Internally, you work with product engineering teams to improve our products by conveying feedback from developers, reviewing API designs and testing new features. Chrome, Android, App Engine, HTML5 as well as our core Google Apps and Ads APIs are just some of the platforms you promote and support.
With your technical expertise, you drive strategy around fostering a community of developers who work with Google technologies. An ardent advocate for these developers, you represent their voice internally to our Product Managers and serve as their Google support in application development and technology implementation.

As a Cloud Developer Relations Engineer, you’ll join a team of Practitioners that empathize deeply with external technical communities, and advocate on their behalf to the Google Cloud Product and Engineering teams, ensuring that our products are built to meet the community's needs and that they provide the best possible user and developer experiences. You’ll work to raise awareness of Cloud technologies and methodologies within our technical communities through enablement and inspiration, and you’ll drive strategy around Google Developer Relations efforts for specific communities and products.

Responsibilities

  • Advocate for the community internally and influence Google Cloud product strategy by working with cross-functional teams. Support an inclusive work environment.
  • Synthesize feedback in order to drive continuous improvement to Google Cloud Platform products and to the overall experience of the platform by technical practitioners.
  • Participate in technical communities as a practitioner having, or developing, deep understanding of that community’s needs. Build and foster an external community ecosystem of influencers, meetups, experts that amplify messages and extend the reach.
  • Represent the needs of relevant technical communities throughout the entire product lifecycle, including input on design discussions, customer zero testing, launch, post-launch updates.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to define product strategies and to craft narratives around new products and features.

description:

ADVOGADA (O) PLENO – AMBIENTAL – CORPORATIVO

VAGA PREFERENCIAL PARA MULHERES

Nossa transformação cultural:

A Vale é uma mineradora que busca acelerar a transição para um mundo mais sustentável, que coloca a segurança no centro de tudo o que faz e trabalha para construir soluções para os desafios da humanidade - transformando, hoje, o futuro. Aprendemos juntos, e seguimos comprometidos com a nossa transformação cultural para gerar, com as pessoas, valor e impacto positivo por meio das nossas atividades. Avançando a cada dia, nos sentimos prontos para cultivar relações sólidas e estabelecer sempre o diálogo aberto com a sociedade.

#vemcom avale

Conheça mais do nosso propósito:

Por que vagas preferenciais para mulheres?

A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Além disso, acreditamos que o avanço em equidade de gênero contribui para a construção de um futuro melhor para todos. Queremos aumentar a representatividade de todas as mulheres: pretas, brancas, com qualquer identidade de gênero e orientação sexual ou que tenham algum tipo de deficiência.

Entendemos que iniciativas com foco em vagas exclusivas contribuem para avanços na criação de um ambiente cada vez mais colaborativo, inovador e atrativo para novos talentos. Por isso, valorizamos em diferentes ações e processos seletivos a participação de todos os diferentes perfis de candidatos e candidatas, nas diferentes dimensões de grupos que integram a agenda de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

O processo seletivo para essa posição segue o mesmo formato dos outros programas de atração de talentos da empresa.

Quer conhecer nossa oportunidade?

N° do CD (Cargo disponível): 1083273

N° de Vagas: 01

Formação: Graduação completa em Direito

Localidade: Nova Lima, MG, Brasil

Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à sexta de 09:00h as 18:00h

Tipo de contrato: Indeterminado

Período de inscrição: de 23/04/2025 a 29/04/2025

Requisitos necessários:

  • Graduação em Direito, com registro ativo na OAB;
  • Experiência comprovada na defesa de empresas em temas relacionados ao Direito Civil e Direito Ambiental;

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Inglês Fluente.

Responsabilidades e atividades do cargo:

  • Atuação estratégica em ações judiciais relacionadas ao Direito Ambiental, com foco em regularização e defesa de processos envolvendo licenças ambientais e outorgas;
  • Gestão de processos e elaboração de defesas em ações judiciais envolvendo eventos climáticos, como enchentes e seus impactos socioambientais;
  • Atuação em ações relacionadas à preservação e proteção do Patrimônio Cultural, com interface com órgãos de controle e autoridades competentes;
  • Análise e acompanhamento de Autos de Infração emitidos por órgãos ambientais, com foco em mitigação de riscos e condução de estratégias jurídicas de defesa.

Um pouco do que a Vale oferece para você:

  • Previdência Privada: garantia de um futuro tranquilo, com segurança financeira para a aposentadoria.
  • PLR - Programa de Participação nos Lucros e Resultados: reconhecimento pelos esforços de todos, com participação nos lucros da empresa.
  • Assistência Médica e Hospitalar, Odontológica: Cuidados de saúde completos para empregados e seus dependentes, prezando por aquilo que é prioritário em garantir: Saúde e qualidade de vida;
  • Reembolso Creche ou Auxílio Babá: apoio para conciliar o retorno ao trabalho com a chegada de um filho - até os 6 anos dos dependentes;
  • PASA - Planos de saúde para familiares ou para o próprio empregado, em caso de aposentadoria ou desligamento;
  • Vale alimentação: suporte financeiro para compras de itens de mercado;
  • Vale refeição ou Refeições no trabalho: benefício para facilitar a rotina e promover hábitos saudáveis na alimentação diária;
  • Apoiar - Programa de Assistência ao Empregado e Dependentes: suporte emocional e social especializados para empregados e suas famílias;
  • Cartão Presente de Natal para Dependentes: um gesto de carinho no final do ano - para dependentes até 10 anos;
  • Transporte fretado ou Vale transporte: garantia de deslocamento diário de nossos empregados para o ambiente de trabalho;
  • Passagens de trem: de passageiros na Estrada de Ferro Vitória a Minas (EFVM) e/ou na Estrada de Ferro Carajás (EFC). Destinadas para uso pessoal, viabilizando mais uma opção logística para viagens dos empregados;
  • Incentivo à atividade física - Wellhub: promoção de saúde física e bem-estar com programas de atividade física;
  • Programa Bem-Estar: cuidados integrais para melhorar a qualidade de vida dos empregados;
  • Clube de Vantagens: Descontos e benefícios exclusivos para compras em estabelecimentos parceiros.

Entre outros ...

Como é trabalhar na Vale?

Na Vale, contribuímos para a formação de futuros. Da mineração, do planeta e o seu. Oferecemos oportunidades para diversas áreas e objetivos profissionais. Aqui, nossos talentos constroem juntos um ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo que valoriza a pessoa como ela é: sua individualidade, seu protagonismo e comprometimento.

Na Vale, aprendemos juntos. Acreditamos na riqueza das experiências do dia a dia e na troca de conhecimento entre os talentos. Aqui, todo momento pode e deve ser um aprendizado.

Na Vale, também crescemos juntos. Estabelecemos relações sólidas e de valor compartilhado com os nossos empregados e a sociedade. Assim, demonstramos nosso comprometimento com um legado positivo, resultados consistentes e com a construção de uma mineração com processos mais inovadores e sustentáveis: a mineração do futuro.

Onde tem futuro, a Vale está.

What we are looking for
  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.

  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
